description: Image Description: The image depicts a serene beach scene during what appears to be early morning or late afternoon, indicated by the position of the sun low in the sky, casting a bright glow over the horizon. Two surfboards lie on the sandy beach, with one prominently in the foreground and the other slightly further away near the water's edge. The surfboards are positioned parallel to the shoreline, which stretches towards the horizon on the left side of the image. The sand is textured with footprints and small debris
